Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have for you folks. Pakistan win another series under the captaincy of Sarfraz Ahmed. Tomorrow, on 3rd April, Tuesday, is the last and final T20I of the series. Join us then again for that as we bring you all the live updates from the game which begins at 1930 local (1430 GMT). Till then, ta-ta!

Sarfraz Ahmed, the Pakistan skipper, is all praises to god and his team. He says that it is the players that win him the game and not his captaincy. On his captaincy, he adds by saying that he tries to stay calm and win every game. Opines that the whole staff is good and the boys are doing well to stay fit. Finally ends by thanking the crowd for their support.

Windies skipper, Jason Mohammed, says that he is disappointed with the team's performance but credits the batters for a better show. He states that it is difficult to set a field for the opposition as they keep on attacking. He ends by saying they will try and win the last game before going back home.

Babar Azam, the Man of the Match winner, says that he is unlucky not to get to his 100 but is happy with the way he batted. He continues saying that the plan was to bat 20 overs and he did just that. Ends by saying that it helps playing along with Fakhar Zaman as he takes away the pressure from him so that he can play his game.

Rameez Raja is down with Shadab Khan for an interview. The leggie states that he cannot grip the ball when there is dew so prefers bowling the leg spin instead of the googly. He says that there is a good atmosphere in the dressing room with the youngsters and they enjoy their time together. He adds by saying that they feel confident after the Pakistan T20 League and now are happy with the series win. Ends by saying that they are high on confidence and overjoyed with the crowd support.

The hosts were dominant with the ball and energetic in the field. Everybody, barring Faheem Ashraf, contributed to the visitor's downfall. Mohammad Amir showed his class and experience as he led the charge with a 3-fer. The rest did their job and bagged the win for the home crowd to celebrate. Earlier in the day, a century stand between Babar Azam (who barely missed out on a ton), and Hussain Talat and some late lusty blows from Shoaib Malik got Pakistan to a score which eventually proved too much for the Windies.

Two emphatic wins for Pakistan in two days. They outplayed Windies in all departments and came out victors on the other side of this contest. Chasing a target of 206, the tourists needed a blazing start to stand any chance, but that never happened as the Pakistan bowlers kept things tight and picked wickets at regular intervals. There wasn't a single fifty-run partnership in the Windies innings which should say everything in itself.

OUT! PAKISTAN WIN BY 82 RUNS! Another massive win for the hosts. Fuller ball on the stumps, Smith looks to go big downtown. No distance on this, as it sails towards long off. Mohammad Nawaz there comes running in and takes a good diving catch to finish things up.
Angling in on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Hussain Talat will bowl the final over of the game.
FOUR! Smashed! Full and just outside off, Smith makes room for himself and hits it hard between cover and mid off for a boundary.
Outside off on a length, Smith plays and misses.
Quite full again, this time Smith drives it through mid on and gets two runs for it.
Extremely full, on off stump, played right back to the bowler.
Short of a good length outside off, Badree rises on his toes and drops it on the off side for a single.
Samuel Badree is the last batsman in.

OUT! Another wicket down! Windies could be wrapped up here completely before the 20 overs. Full and straight from Hasan Ali, Williams has to connect otherwise he's gone. He doesn't, and has his stumps rattled behind.
Hasan Ali returns to the attack.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Odean Smith, the debutant, is out to bat.

OUT! Silly run out. No clue what's going on out there. Slanting away on a length, outside off, Emrit opens the face and dabs it behind point. Ashraf runs to his right from third man and cuts it off, before throwing it back to the keeper. Now, what should have been an easy run turns into a disaster as Emrit comes back for the second. His partner has no idea about this. Both batsmen are at the same end, so Sarfraz runs with the ball to the bowler's end and takes the bails off.
Kesrick Williams will bat now.

OUT! Keemo's fun little stay in the middle comes to an end. Length ball around off, Paul swings hard and gets a big top edge. It flies down towards third man where Faheem Ashraf runs in from the deep and takes a good catch.
FOUR! He's enjoying himself out there! Full ball attacking the stumps, Paul stays leg side and smacks this powerfully through the cover area. Beats the fielder and gets a boundary to his name.
In the air... but danger averted this time. Fuller in length, it's the slower one again. Paul lofts this across the line over mid-wicket. Falls safely and two runs are taken.
Rayad Emrit is the new man in.

OUT! One more scalp for Amir. Fuller and slower on off, the lack of pace deceives Powell as he's early into the lofted shot. He balloons it towards cover where Babar Azam settles underneath it, before taking a safe catch.
Another one worked away on the leg side for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Uses the angle well to flick this through mid-wicket. One run taken.
Full toss, punched through covers for one run.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Paul! He backs away to this back of a length delivery on off and forces the punch past the diving mid off fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! That went like a rocket! Short delivery into the body, Keemo Paul nails the pull through square leg. No fielder out there moved an inch, it went that quickly.
Hasan Ali back on.
Looks to go big but he's made no clear connection on that. Clears his front leg and lofts it to long on on the bounce. Single taken.
Almost a yorker, well outside off this time, Paul drills it but straight to the man at cover.
Marginally ahead of a length, on off and shaping away, it's played to the left of the bowler by Paul. No run taken.
Keemo Paul walks in next.

OUT! Pinpoint yorker from Mohammad Amir. Right on the money. Fires it on the stumps, Jason Mohammed makes room looking to squeeze it away square on the off side, but it's too good for him and he has his stumps rattled. No chance to play that one. Was absolutely perfect from Amir. He picks up his first wicket of the game.
Moving away from around off, on a length, pushed away from the body to the covers for a single.
Full in length and swinging away from middle and leg, Mohammed checks his shot and chips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Rovman Powell joins the skipper in the middle. Also, Mohammad Amir is back into the attack.

OUT! Slow ball bouncer around off, Ramdin pulls this away. He doesn't time it well enough and the ball goes towards the deep mid-wicket region where Hassan Ali settles under it and takes the catch comfortably. Ramdin who just started to get a move falls.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Bangs this one short, Jason goes for the pull but gets hit on his body. No damage done.
FOUR! This is poor bowling from Talat. Length ball down the leg, Mohammed whips it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Full on middle, Jason makes room, gets low and slices this over covers for a one bounce boundary.
Full on leg, Ramdin flicks it away for one.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads as Ramdin misses his flick. They cross as the ball moves far from the fielder.
Appeal for caught behind but not given. Ali saw Ramdin making room so shortened his length. Cramped him for room and made it too close to cut. Almost ended up edging that to the keeper.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Short ball, Ramdin pulls this to the square leg fielder for a dot.
SIX! Ramdin getting a late move on. Lofts this overpitched ball over mid-wicket for a biggie. Too little too late for the Windies.
Back of a length ball, Jason punches this to the cover region for one.
Hassan Ali comes back into the attack.
Slow ball outside off, Ramdin makes room but fails to cut it.
Ramdin square cuts this to the fielder at point for nothing.
SIX! Gets hold of this one and deposits this over the fence. Slower ball in line of the stumps, Ramdin gets on one knee and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Darts this quick around off, Ramdin drives this crisply through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up, Jason tries to sweep this but misses his shot. The ball hits him and rolls to the leg side where they steal a leg bye.
Gives this air, Mohammed leans forward and defends it.
Jason plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One more run added to the total. The required rate now climbs over 18.
Ramdin opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
Short ball, Ramdin pulls this to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length in line of the stumps, Dinesh is happy to play that with a straight bat.
Finds the point fielder again. Another dot ball.
Length ball outside off, Ramdin cuts this to the fielder at point.
Slower through the air, Jason plays this to mid-wicket.
Floated ball, Dinesh drives this through covers for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short again, Ramdin rocks back and taps it to the fielder to the off side.
Back of a length ball, Ramdin punches this off his back foot.
Dinesh Ramdin is the next man in.

OUT! Samuels holes out trying to push up his scoring. Tossed up ball from Khan and Marlon looks to loft this over long off. He gets under the ball but cannot hit this over Asif Ali stationed there who takes it just ahead of the boundary line. Things looking very tough for the tourists from here.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Samuels drives but can't beat a diving Hasan Ali at extra cover. Good effort from him over there. Keeps the batsmen to just a single.
Picks it off his pads and nudges it square on the leg side. One run taken.
Served around off, spinning away, Mohammed comes half-forward and blocks.
A change of bats for Marlon Samuels.
One bounce to the fielder. Takes the aerial route but can't middle it. Marlon lofts it to long on and gets off strike.
Quicker and shorter, angling in on middle, whipped along the ground through to deep mid-wicket. Single added to the total.
Slower through the air from around the wicket, fuller on middle, worked to the long on fielder for an easy run.
Mohammad Nawaz is back on.
Googly on middle and leg, it goes off the batsman's pads and down towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Leans ahead and knocks this down to long on for a single.
Flat and short outside off, cut hard but straight to the man at point.
Loopy leg break outside off, Mohammed goes with the turn and pushes it into the off side.
Another googly, outside off, it's dabbed to point.
Jason Mohammed is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! No problem for Shadab. It's the wrong 'un which gets Walton. Landed around off, Walton gets low to go big across the line. Doesn't pick up the googly and as a result, leaves a big gap between bat and pad. Through the gate and the bails are off. Perfect delivery.
Hold up! Chadwick Walton is bowled but the umpire wants to check whether the leggie has overstepped or not. Let's see what happens here...
Pulls this short ball over mid-wicket and takes a single to end the over.
Through mid-wicket again, single taken.
Yorker fired in on middle and off, Samuels opens the face to drive it through covers but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Works it with the angle through the vacant mid-wicket area and takes one.

SIX! Innovative stuff from Chadwick Walton. Displaying his versatile skill set for everyone to see. Full on the stumps, he gets low and across before playing the scoop shot over fine leg for a maximum.
Tad fuller in length outside off, driven to mid off.
Faheem Ashraf is brought into the attack.
Outside off on a fuller length, played to cover.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Googly dropped short, around off, Walton is lucky he gets an inside edge on this one. The ball rapped his pads afterwards and he would have been gone then.
SIX! Shot of the match so far! Lovely use of the feet from Walton, he skips down, gets close to the pitch and goes inside out over covers. Smokes it over extra cover and clears the fence with ease.
Outside the line of off stump, cut away square but straight to the fielder.
FOUR! Poor start from the leggie! Drops it short and flat on middle stump, Walton goes back and muscles the pull over mid-wicket, beating the man in the deep for a boundary.
Shadab Khan is on to bowl now.
Short and outside off, pushed away into the off side.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Almost a catch! Cutter on off, Samuels spoons it back just over the bowler's head. Hasan Ali leaps to take it but just misses. One run taken.
Shortish again, worked just wide of mid on for a single.
Good length ball around off, flat-batted to mid on for no run.
FOUR! Too full from Hasan Ali and he's paid the price. On the stumps, Walton lofts it cleanly over mid on and sends the ball across the rope.
Hasan Ali is the first bowling change.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Streaky runs but Marlon won't mind! Short and wide, Samuels rocks back to cut but gets a thick edge. It flies past short third man and runs away to the boundary line.

Not out! Some bat saves him. Arm ball on middle and leg, sliding down further a bit, Walton is down to sweep this away. He's rapped on the front pad and there's a loud appeal. The umpire says no, but Pakistan review. Although, Sarfraz isn't too sure about it. And his doubt is correct, replays show why. There's an inside edge on this one. So, Walton is safe. Single taken too as the batsmen had crossed over. Pakistan also lose their review.
Review time. A referral for an lbw appeal against Chadwick Walton is taken upstairs.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Plants his front foot forward and knocks it down to mid on.
Full and on the stumps, flicked with the wrists towards mid-wicket. Dot ball.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Chadwick Walton! Down the leg side, he just helps this towards the fine leg fence and picks up a boundary.
Shortish in length, around off, pulled away, but straight to mid on.
Slightly fullish in length and going across, Samuels clears his front leg and slogs it from the inside half through the mid-wicket area for a single.
Short of a good length but a fraction straight in line, flicked in front of square leg to rotate strike.
Sprays it on the hips, easy enough for the batsman to work it through square leg for one run.
Excellent. Good length delivery on middle and leg, it angles away late and forces Samuels to defend it.
Landed on a driving length, outside off, pushed to the cover area to end the over.
Plays with the turn and pushes it away into the off side.
Short and outside off, Samuels gets off the mark with a back foot punch to long off. Single taken.
A hint of turn on this occasion. Tossed up on middle and leg, Marlon plays it back down towards mid on.
Straighter one, full outside off, Samuels goes for the drive but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Marlon Samuels is in at No.3.

OUT! He's chopped it back on! Sarfraz slips as he celebrates but he won't mind at all. Fletcher's struggles continue. Quick, short and flat on off, it's coming in with the angle. Fletcher looks to cut when there's no room to do so. He ends up playing it back onto the stumps and the bails are off. Early breakthrough for Pakistan.
Just behind a length, on middle and off, the batsman gets behind the line and blocks it back down the track.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Overpitched around off, Walton leans beautifully into this and drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
Another mishit. Short of a good length angling across, Chadwick Walton walks down the track but mistimes the punch back to the bowler.
Length delivery on the stumps, looks to go over the infield but mishits this towards mid on.
Short of a good length on the off stick, it's played off the inner half towards the mid-wicket area.
Short and wide outside off, Walton misses out as he looks to cut this away. Gets a bottom edge behind on a couple of bounce to the slip cordon.
Mohammad Amir will bowl from the other end.
Was in the air for a bit but it's safe. Tossed up on off, Walton leans ahead and spoons a safe leading edge past mid off for a single.
Fullish in length and outside off, a firm block in front of cover by Walton off the front foot.
Short once more, worked away off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Short again, flat once more, it's punched towards mid on.
Works this away to the mid-wicket area and crosses over.
FOUR! Perfect start to the innings! Short and flat on off, Walton rocks back and whips this with perfect timing through mid-wicket for a boundary.

We are back for the chase. A mountain to climb for Windies, but it is doable. Chadwick Walton and Andre Fletcher will begin that climb by opening the innings, as Mohammad Nawaz will try to stop them. Here we go...
